title: Jesus' Family Tree
summary: Matthew opens with Jesus' ancestry, tracing it from Abraham through King David and the exile in Babylon to Joseph. He groups it into three sets of fourteen generations.

title: A Surprise Baby and a Dream
summary: Mary is pregnant before she and Joseph are married. An angel tells Joseph in a dream the child is from the Holy Spirit and to name him Jesus. Joseph obeys and takes Mary as his wife.

title: Wise Men Follow a Star
summary: Wise men from the east arrive in Jerusalem looking for the newborn King of the Jews. Herod is rattled, and the scholars point to Bethlehem. The star leads the wise men there.

title: Gifts, a Warning, and an Escape
summary: The wise men worship Jesus and give gold, frankincense and myrrh. Warned in a dream, they skip Herod, and Joseph takes his family to Egypt.

title: Herod's Terrible Rage
summary: Furious that the wise men tricked him, Herod has the boys in Bethlehem under two killed. Matthew sees this as echoing Jeremiah's words about Rachel weeping.

title: Home to Nazareth
summary: After Herod dies, an angel tells Joseph to go back. Wary of Herod's son ruling Judea, Joseph settles the family in Nazareth in Galilee.

title: John the Baptist Shows Up
summary: John preaches in the Judean wilderness, telling people to change their hearts because God's kingdom is near. Crowds come to be baptized and confess their sins.

title: Straight Talk to the Religious Elite
summary: John calls out Pharisees and Sadducees who come for baptism, telling them to prove their change with real fruit. He says someone mightier is coming.

title: Jesus Is Baptized
summary: Jesus comes to John to be baptized. The heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a voice declares Jesus is God's beloved Son.

title: Tested in the Wilderness
summary: After fasting forty days, Jesus is tempted by the devil to make bread, to jump from the temple, and to take all kingdoms by worship. He answers each with Scripture and the devil leaves.

title: Ministry Begins in Galilee
summary: Hearing John has been arrested, Jesus moves to Capernaum. Matthew sees this as fulfilling Isaiah's light for Galilee. Jesus starts preaching that God's kingdom is near.

title: Fishermen Become Followers
summary: Walking by the Sea of Galilee, Jesus calls fishermen brothers Simon Peter and Andrew, then James and John. They drop their nets and follow him.

title: Healing and Big Crowds
summary: Jesus teaches, preaches and heals every kind of sickness across Galilee. News spreads and huge crowds follow him from all around.

title: The Beatitudes
summary: Jesus sits on a mountain and begins the Sermon on the Mount, teaching who is truly blessed: the humble, mourning, merciful, pure in heart, peacemakers and persecuted. He promises them God's kingdom.

title: Salt and Light
summary: Jesus says his followers are the salt of the earth and the light of the world. They should let their good deeds shine so others praise God.

title: Not Here to Cancel the Law
summary: Jesus says he came to fulfill the Law and Prophets, not abolish them. He calls for a righteousness deeper than that of the scribes and Pharisees.

title: Anger Counts Too
summary: Murder is wrong, but Jesus says holding anger and insults against someone is serious too. He urges making peace quickly, even before worship.

title: Heart Matters in Love and Marriage
summary: Jesus says lustful looks are a kind of adultery and urges radical steps to avoid sin. He also teaches on divorce, limiting it.

title: Just Say Yes or No
summary: Instead of swearing oaths, Jesus says to keep it simple: let your yes be yes and your no be no.

title: Don't Hit Back
summary: Jesus overturns an eye-for-an-eye mindset. Turn the other cheek, give more than asked, go the extra mile, and be generous to those who ask.

title: Love Your Enemies
summary: Jesus says to love enemies and pray for those who persecute you, just as God gives sun and rain to all. Be complete, like your heavenly Father.

title: Give Quietly
summary: Jesus says to do good deeds without showing off. Give in secret, and your Father who sees it will reward you.

title: How to Pray
summary: Don't pray to be seen or babble on. Jesus gives a simple model, the Lord's Prayer, and stresses forgiving others as we are forgiven.

title: Fasting Without the Drama
summary: When you fast, don't look gloomy to impress people. Do it privately and let God see.

title: Real Treasure
summary: Store up treasure in heaven, not on earth where it rots or gets stolen. Where your treasure is, your heart will be.

title: Stop Worrying
summary: You can't serve both God and money. Jesus says don't stress over food or clothes: God feeds birds and clothes flowers, and cares even more for you. Seek his kingdom first.

title: Don't Be a Judge
summary: Jesus warns against harsh judging and says to remove the plank from your own eye before the speck in someone else's. He also cautions about giving holy things to those who'll trample them.

title: Ask, Seek, Knock
summary: Keep asking, seeking and knocking, because God gives good things like a loving father. Jesus sums up the Law with the Golden Rule: treat others as you want to be treated.

title: Two Roads
summary: Jesus describes a narrow gate leading to life and a wide gate leading to destruction. Few find the narrow one.

title: Fruit Check
summary: Beware of false prophets, who are known by their fruit. Saying 'Lord, Lord' isn't enough; what counts is doing the Father's will.

title: Two Builders
summary: Whoever hears and does Jesus' words is like a man building on rock, safe through storms. Whoever doesn't is like one building on sand. The crowds are amazed at his authority.

title: A Man with Leprosy Healed
summary: A man with leprosy kneels and asks Jesus to make him clean. Jesus touches him and heals him, telling him to show the priest.

title: The Centurion's Great Faith
summary: A Roman officer asks Jesus to heal his servant from afar, trusting that Jesus' word is enough. Jesus is amazed at his faith and heals the servant.

title: Peter's Mother-in-Law and Many More
summary: Jesus heals Peter's feverish mother-in-law, and in the evening many sick and troubled people are brought to him and healed.

title: The Cost of Following
summary: Jesus tells would-be followers that he has no place to rest his head and that following him comes first, even before other duties.

title: Jesus Calms the Storm
summary: A fierce storm hits the lake while Jesus sleeps in the boat. The terrified disciples wake him, and he calms wind and waves with a word.

title: Demons and the Pigs
summary: In Gadara, Jesus meets two fierce demon-possessed men. He sends the demons into a herd of pigs that rush into the sea. The townspeople ask him to leave.

title: Forgiven, Then Walking
summary: Jesus tells a paralyzed man his sins are forgiven. Challenged by scribes, he proves his authority by healing the man, who walks home.

title: Dinner with Matthew
summary: Jesus calls tax collector Matthew to follow him and eats with sinners. He tells critics he came for the sick, not the healthy, wanting mercy over sacrifice.

title: Why Don't Your Disciples Fast?
summary: Asked about fasting, Jesus says wedding guests don't mourn while the bridegroom is there. New wine needs new wineskins.

title: A Girl Raised and a Woman Healed
summary: As Jesus heads to a ruler's house, a woman who's been bleeding twelve years touches his cloak and is healed. He then raises the ruler's daughter from death.

title: Sight, Speech and Skeptics
summary: Jesus heals two blind men because of their faith and frees a mute man from a demon. Crowds are amazed; Pharisees accuse him of using demon power.

title: Harvest Is Big, Workers Few
summary: Jesus tours the towns teaching and healing, and feels compassion for crowds like sheep without a shepherd. He asks for prayer for more workers.

title: The Twelve Are Sent
summary: Jesus names his twelve apostles and gives them power to heal and cast out demons. He sends them to Israel's lost sheep with instructions to travel light and rely on hospitality.

title: Sheep Among Wolves
summary: Jesus warns that his followers will face hostility, arrests and family betrayal. They should be wise and gentle, and the Holy Spirit will help them speak. Endure to the end.

title: Don't Be Afraid
summary: Don't fear people who can only hurt the body. God cares even about sparrows and counts your hairs. Those who acknowledge Jesus will be acknowledged by him.

title: Jesus Divides Households
summary: Jesus says he brings a sword, meaning loyalty to him may split families. Loving him must come first, and taking up your cross means losing life to find it.

title: Welcome and Reward
summary: Whoever welcomes Jesus' followers welcomes him and the Father. Even a cup of cold water given to one of them will be rewarded.

title: John's Doubts
summary: John, in prison, sends disciples to ask if Jesus is the one. Jesus points to the healings and good news being preached as the answer.

title: Jesus Praises John
summary: Jesus tells the crowd John was more than a prophet, the messenger who prepares the way. Elijah-like, he is the greatest born of women.

title: A Fickle Generation
summary: Jesus compares people to kids who won't play along. They rejected John as too strict and Jesus as too loose. Wisdom is proved by its results.

title: Towns That Didn't Listen
summary: Jesus scolds Chorazin, Bethsaida and Capernaum for ignoring his miracles. He says even Tyre, Sidon and Sodom would have repented.

title: Hidden from the Wise
summary: Jesus thanks the Father for revealing truth to the childlike rather than the self-wise. Only the Son knows the Father and those he chooses to show.

title: Come and Rest
summary: Jesus invites the weary and burdened to come to him for rest. His yoke is easy and his burden light, because he is gentle and humble.

title: Lord of the Sabbath
summary: The disciples pick grain on the Sabbath and Pharisees object. Jesus cites David and says he himself is Lord of the Sabbath, preferring mercy to sacrifice.

title: Healing on the Sabbath
summary: In a synagogue, Jesus is asked if healing on the Sabbath is lawful. He says doing good is, and heals a man's withered hand.

title: The Gentle Servant
summary: The Pharisees plot to destroy Jesus, so he withdraws and keeps healing. Matthew sees Isaiah's gentle servant in him, one who won't break a bruised reed.

title: A House Divided
summary: After Jesus heals a demon-possessed man, Pharisees say it's by Beelzebul. Jesus replies a divided kingdom can't stand and that he is overpowering the strong man.

title: Words Matter
summary: Jesus warns that speaking against the Holy Spirit won't be forgiven. A tree is known by fruit, and people will answer for careless words.

title: The Sign of Jonah
summary: Asked for a sign, Jesus says the only one is Jonah: three days in the fish foreshadows his burial. Ninevites and the Queen of Sheba will judge this generation.

title: Who Is My Family?
summary: Told his mother and brothers are outside, Jesus points to his disciples. Whoever does the Father's will is his family.

title: The Farmer and the Seed
summary: Jesus tells a crowd by the sea about a farmer scattering seed on a path, rocks, thorns and good soil, with very different results.

title: Why Parables?
summary: Jesus tells his disciples that secrets of the kingdom are given to them, while many who see and hear don't really understand. Blessed are eyes that see.

title: The Seed Explained
summary: Jesus explains the soils: the word can be snatched, shallow, choked by worries and wealth, or taken in and bear much fruit.

title: Wheat and Weeds
summary: A farmer's enemy sows weeds among the wheat. He lets both grow until harvest, when they will be separated.

title: Tiny Mustard Seed
summary: God's kingdom starts small like a mustard seed but grows into a big tree where birds nest.

title: Yeast in the Dough
summary: The kingdom is like yeast a woman works through a large batch of flour. Jesus speaks in parables, fulfilling an old prophecy.

title: Weeds Explained
summary: Alone with disciples, Jesus explains the weeds: the field is the world, the good seed God's people, and angels will separate them at the end.

title: Hidden Treasure and Fine Pearl
summary: The kingdom is like a treasure in a field or a priceless pearl. A finder sells everything to get it.

title: The Fishing Net
summary: The kingdom is like a net catching all kinds of fish, which get sorted at the end. A wise teacher draws on both old and new treasures.

title: Hometown Rejection
summary: Jesus returns to Nazareth, where people are amazed but offended, knowing him as the carpenter's son. Because of their unbelief, he does few miracles there.

title: Herod and John's Death
summary: Herod hears about Jesus and fears John the Baptist has come back to life. The story flashes back to Herod's birthday party, a dance, a rash promise, and John's beheading.

title: Feeding the Five Thousand
summary: Jesus withdraws, but crowds follow, and he heals them. Evening comes, and with five loaves and two fish he feeds about five thousand men, plus women and children, with twelve baskets left.

title: Walking on Water
summary: Jesus sends the disciples ahead and prays alone. He walks to them on the stormy lake; Peter steps out too but sinks when afraid. Jesus catches him and the wind stops.

title: Healing at Gennesaret
summary: In Gennesaret people bring all their sick to Jesus. Those who merely touch his cloak's edge are healed.

title: Clean Hands, Dirty Hearts
summary: Pharisees from Jerusalem complain that the disciples skip the hand-washing ritual. Jesus fires back that their traditions let people dodge God's commands, like caring for parents, and calls their lip-service hypocrisy.

title: What Really Makes You Unclean
summary: Jesus tells the crowd it's not what goes into your mouth that defiles you but what comes out. He explains to Peter and the others that words and actions flow from the heart, so unwashed hands are no big deal.

title: The Persistent Canaanite Mother
summary: In the region of Tyre and Sidon, a Canaanite woman begs Jesus to heal her tormented daughter. He tests her, but she answers with quick wit and strong faith, and he heals her daughter on the spot.

title: Healing on the Mountain
summary: Back by the Sea of Galilee, huge crowds bring the lame, blind, mute and injured to Jesus. He heals them all, and the people are amazed and praise God.

title: Feeding the Four Thousand
summary: Jesus doesn't want the hungry crowd to go home on empty stomachs. With seven loaves and a few fish he feeds about four thousand men plus women and children, with seven baskets left over.

title: No Sign for You
summary: The Pharisees and Sadducees demand a miraculous sign. Jesus says they can read the weather but miss the bigger picture, and the only sign they'll get is the sign of Jonah.

title: Watch Out for the Yeast
summary: The disciples forget bread, so they think Jesus' warning about 'yeast' is about that. He reminds them of the two miracle feedings and clarifies he meant the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Who Do You Say I Am?
summary: At Caesarea Philippi Jesus asks what people say about him, then asks the disciples directly. Peter declares him the Christ, Son of the living God, and Jesus praises him, promising to build his church on this rock.

title: Peter Pushes Back
summary: Jesus starts explaining he must suffer, be killed and rise on the third day. Peter objects, and Jesus sharply rebukes him for thinking in human terms rather than God's.

title: The Cost of Following
summary: Jesus says following him means giving up your own way and taking up your cross. Gaining the whole world isn't worth losing your soul, and he promises he will return in glory.

title: Glowing on the Mountain
summary: Jesus takes Peter, James and John up a mountain, where he shines brilliantly and Moses and Elijah appear. A voice from a cloud says 'This is my beloved Son; listen to him.' Coming down, Jesus talks about Elijah and John the Baptist.

title: The Boy the Disciples Couldn't Heal
summary: A father begs Jesus to heal his seizure-stricken son after the disciples failed. Jesus heals the boy, then tells the disciples that even mustard-seed-sized faith can move mountains.

title: Jesus Predicts His Death Again
summary: In Galilee Jesus again tells the disciples he'll be betrayed, killed and raised on the third day. They are heartbroken.

title: The Fish with the Coin
summary: Tax collectors in Capernaum ask whether Jesus pays the temple tax. He says he's technically exempt but sends Peter to catch a fish with a coin in its mouth to cover both of them.

title: Who's the Greatest?
summary: The disciples ask who is greatest in God's kingdom. Jesus puts a child in front of them and says humble, childlike people are the greatest, and warns against causing little ones to stumble.

title: Don't Lead Anyone Astray
summary: Jesus uses dramatic imagery to say sin is worth taking very seriously. He then tells the lost sheep parable: God cares about every single person and doesn't want any to be lost.

title: When a Friend Wrongs You
summary: Jesus lays out a step-by-step way to handle conflict: talk privately first, then bring one or two others, and finally involve the community. He promises to be present wherever two or three gather in his name.

title: How Many Times to Forgive?
summary: Peter asks if forgiving seven times is enough. Jesus says more like seventy times seven.

title: The Servant Who Wouldn't Forgive
summary: A king forgives a servant's gigantic debt, but that servant then throws a coworker into prison over a tiny one. The king is furious, and Jesus says God expects us to forgive others from the heart.

title: Questions About Divorce
summary: Great crowds follow Jesus into Judea, and he heals them. Pharisees test him on divorce, and he points back to God's original design for marriage, saying Moses allowed divorce only because of hard hearts.

title: Not Everyone Marries
summary: The disciples say that if that's the standard, maybe marriage isn't worth it. Jesus says this teaching isn't for everyone and that some people stay single for the kingdom.

title: Let the Kids Come
summary: People bring children for Jesus to bless and the disciples shoo them away. Jesus says to let the children come, because the kingdom belongs to people like them.

title: The Rich Young Man
summary: A wealthy young man asks what he must do for eternal life. He's kept the commandments, but when Jesus tells him to sell everything and follow him, he walks away sad.

title: Camels and Needles
summary: Jesus says it's very hard for the rich to enter the kingdom, like a camel through a needle's eye. The stunned disciples ask who can be saved, and he says that with God all things are possible.

title: Workers in the Vineyard
summary: A landowner hires workers at different times of day, then pays everyone the same wage. The early workers grumble, but he says he's free to be generous. Jesus ends with 'the last will be first.'

title: The Third Prediction
summary: On the way up to Jerusalem Jesus tells the twelve plainly that he'll be handed over, mocked, crucified, and raised on the third day.

title: Greatness Means Serving
summary: The mother of James and John asks for top seats for her sons. Jesus says leaders in his kingdom serve others, just as he came to serve and give his life as a ransom for many.

title: Two Blind Men See
summary: Leaving Jericho, two blind men shout for mercy and won't be hushed by the crowd. Jesus stops, touches their eyes, and they can see and follow him.

title: Parade into Jerusalem
summary: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey while crowds spread cloaks and branches and shout 'Hosanna to the Son of David!' The whole city is stirred up asking who he is.

title: Flipping the Temple Tables
summary: Jesus drives the merchants and money changers out of the temple, saying it should be a house of prayer. He heals the blind and lame there, and the offended priests hear children cheering for him.

title: The Fig Tree Withers
summary: Jesus finds a leafy fig tree with no fruit and it withers. He uses it to teach the disciples about faith and prayer: believe, and you can do amazing things.

title: Who Gave You the Authority?
summary: Priests and elders challenge Jesus' authority. He counters by asking whether John's baptism was from heaven or from men, and when they won't answer, he won't either.

title: Two Sons
summary: A father asks two sons to work in the vineyard: one refuses but goes, the other agrees but doesn't. Jesus says tax collectors and sinners who repented are entering God's kingdom ahead of the religious leaders.

title: The Wicked Tenants
summary: Tenant farmers beat and kill the landowner's servants and then his son. Jesus quotes 'the stone the builders rejected,' and the leaders realize the story is about them and want him arrested, but fear the crowds.

title: The Wedding Banquet
summary: A king throws a wedding feast, but the invited guests ignore or mistreat his messengers. So he invites everyone from the streets, though one guest without wedding clothes gets thrown out.

title: Taxes to Caesar?
summary: Pharisees and Herodians try to trap Jesus with a question about paying taxes. He asks whose face is on the coin and says to give Caesar what's Caesar's and God what's God's.

title: Marriage in the Resurrection
summary: The Sadducees, who deny the resurrection, pose a puzzle about a woman who married seven brothers. Jesus says people in the resurrection are like angels, and God is the God of the living.

title: The Greatest Commandment
summary: A Pharisee lawyer asks which commandment is greatest. Jesus says to love God with everything you've got, and to love your neighbor as yourself. All of the law hangs on these two.

title: Whose Son Is the Christ?
summary: Jesus asks the Pharisees how the Messiah can be David's son if David calls him Lord. Nobody can answer, and after that no one dares ask him more questions.

title: Practice What You Preach
summary: Jesus tells the crowds to follow what the scribes and Pharisees teach but not what they do. They love show, titles and the best seats, but real greatness comes from humble service.

title: Seven Woes, Part One
summary: Jesus declares a series of 'woes' on hypocritical religious leaders who shut people out of God's kingdom, exploit the vulnerable, and play word games with oaths. He calls them blind guides.

title: Seven Woes, Part Two
summary: Jesus says they obsess over tiny details like tithing herbs while ignoring justice, mercy and faith. He compares them to polished cups that are dirty inside and to whitewashed tombs, pretty outside but full of death.

title: Jerusalem, Jerusalem
summary: Jesus warns that judgment is coming for the city that kills God's messengers. He mourns, wishing he could gather its people like a hen gathers her chicks, but they weren't willing.

title: The Temple Will Fall
summary: Jesus predicts the temple will be torn down stone by stone. On the Mount of Olives the disciples ask when and what the signs will be, and he describes false messiahs, wars, famines, persecution, and the gospel reaching every nation.

title: Great Trouble Ahead
summary: Jesus warns of a terrible time of trouble in Judea, urging people to flee quickly. He cautions against believing false messiahs, because his return will be as obvious as lightning.

title: The Son of Man Returns
summary: After that trouble, Jesus says, the sky will go dark and the Son of Man will appear in the clouds, gathering his chosen people. Like a fig tree's leaves signal summer, these signs show it's near.

title: No One Knows the Day
summary: No one except the Father knows the day or hour. Jesus compares it to the days of Noah, when life carried on as normal until the flood, and says to stay ready.

title: Faithful or Fed-Up Servant
summary: A servant put in charge is rewarded if found doing his job when the master returns. A servant who slacks off and mistreats others, thinking the master is delayed, gets a nasty surprise.

title: Ten Bridesmaids
summary: Five wise and five foolish bridesmaids wait for the groom. When he arrives at midnight, the foolish ones have run out of lamp oil and miss the party. Jesus says to stay alert.

title: The Three Servants and the Talents
summary: A master leaves money with three servants. Two invest and double it and are praised, but the third buries his and is scolded for being afraid and doing nothing.

title: Sheep and Goats
summary: When the Son of Man returns, he separates people like a shepherd divides sheep from goats. Those who fed, clothed and visited people in need did it for him, while those who ignored them ignored him.

title: The Plot Thickens
summary: Jesus tells the disciples that Passover is two days away and he will be crucified. Meanwhile the chief priests and elders meet at Caiaphas' house to plot how to arrest him quietly.

title: Perfume at Bethany
summary: At Simon's house in Bethany, a woman pours costly perfume on Jesus' head. The disciples grumble about the waste, but Jesus says she's done a beautiful thing, preparing him for burial.

title: Judas Makes a Deal
summary: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, goes to the chief priests and agrees to betray Jesus for thirty pieces of silver. He starts looking for the right moment.

title: The Last Passover Meal
summary: The disciples prepare the Passover, and while they eat Jesus announces that one of them will betray him. Each asks 'Is it me?', and Jesus tells Judas, 'You have said so.'

title: Bread, Wine and Big Promises
summary: Jesus shares bread and wine, calling them his body and his blood, poured out for many. On the way to the Mount of Olives he predicts they'll all desert him, and Peter insists he never will.

title: Praying in Gethsemane
summary: In the garden of Gethsemane Jesus is deeply distressed and prays that the cup might pass, yet says 'your will be done.' Three times he finds his closest disciples asleep.

title: Arrested
summary: Judas arrives with an armed crowd and identifies Jesus with a kiss. A disciple swings a sword and Jesus tells him to put it away, then he's taken, and all the disciples run.

title: On Trial Before the Council
summary: Jesus is taken to Caiaphas and the council, who hunt for false testimony. When asked if he's the Christ, he says yes, and they call it blasphemy, declare him deserving of death, and spit on and strike him.

title: Peter Denies Jesus
summary: In the courtyard Peter is recognized three times as a follower of Jesus, and each time he denies it. When the rooster crows he remembers Jesus' warning and weeps bitterly.

title: Judas Full of Regret
summary: In the morning the leaders hand Jesus over to Pilate. Judas, filled with remorse, returns the silver and says he betrayed an innocent man. The priests refuse it and Judas takes his own life. They buy a field with the money.

title: Jesus Before Pilate
summary: Pilate asks if Jesus is King of the Jews, and Jesus mostly stays silent, which amazes Pilate. He knows the leaders are jealous and offers the crowd a choice between Jesus and the prisoner Barabbas.

title: Give Us Barabbas
summary: Pilate's wife warns him about a troubling dream about Jesus. But the leaders stir up the crowd to ask for Barabbas and shout for Jesus to be crucified. Pilate washes his hands, frees Barabbas, and has Jesus flogged.

title: Mocked by Soldiers
summary: Roman soldiers dress Jesus in a robe, crown him with thorns, hail him as king, and beat him. They then lead him out, force Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross, and arrive at Golgotha.

title: Crucified
summary: Jesus is crucified between two criminals, with a sign reading 'This is Jesus the King of the Jews.' Soldiers divide his clothes, and passersby, leaders and even the criminals taunt him.

title: Jesus Dies
summary: Darkness covers the land for three hours, and Jesus cries out 'My God, why have you forsaken me?' then dies. The temple curtain tears, the earth shakes, tombs open, and a Roman centurion says, 'Truly this was the Son of God.'

title: Buried in a Borrowed Tomb
summary: Women who followed Jesus watch from a distance. A wealthy disciple, Joseph of Arimathea, asks Pilate for the body, wraps it, and lays it in his new tomb with a large stone at the entrance.

title: Guarding the Tomb
summary: The chief priests and Pharisees remember Jesus' prediction of rising after three days. They ask Pilate for guards, then seal the stone and post a watch.

title: He Is Risen
summary: At dawn on Sunday Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go to the tomb. An angel rolls back the stone and tells them Jesus has risen and to tell his disciples. They hurry off, scared and thrilled.

title: Jesus Meets the Women
summary: On the way, Jesus himself appears to the women. They grab his feet and worship him, and he tells them not to be afraid and to send the disciples to Galilee.

title: The Cover Story
summary: Some guards report to the chief priests, who bribe them to say the disciples stole the body while they slept. The soldiers take the money, and the story spreads.

title: The Great Commission
summary: The eleven disciples meet Jesus on a mountain in Galilee. Some worship, some doubt. He says all authority is his and sends them to make disciples of all nations, promising to be with them always.

title: John Gets the Road Ready
summary: Mark opens with John the Baptist in the wilderness, baptizing people and urging them to turn back to God. He says someone far greater is coming.

title: Baptism and Desert Test
summary: Jesus is baptized by John, the Spirit descends like a dove, and God calls him his beloved Son. Then he spends forty days in the wilderness being tempted.

title: Fishermen Drop Their Nets
summary: Jesus starts preaching that God's kingdom is near. He invites Simon, Andrew, James and John to follow him, and they leave their nets and go.

title: Authority in the Synagogue
summary: In Capernaum Jesus teaches with surprising authority and orders an unclean spirit out of a man. The crowd is amazed and word spreads fast.

title: Healing Peter's Mother-in-Law and More
summary: Jesus heals Simon's mother-in-law, then the whole town shows up that evening for healing. At dawn he slips away to pray, then moves on to preach elsewhere.

title: A Man With Leprosy Is Made Clean
summary: A man with leprosy begs for help, and Jesus touches and heals him. He tells him to keep quiet and see the priest, but the man spreads the news anyway.

title: Lowered Through the Roof
summary: Four friends tear open a roof to lower a paralyzed man to Jesus. Jesus forgives his sins, and to prove his authority, tells him to get up and walk home.

title: Dinner With Tax Collectors
summary: Jesus calls Levi, a tax collector, to follow him and then eats with outcasts. He says he came for people who know they need a doctor.

title: Why Aren't Your Disciples Fasting?
summary: Asked about fasting, Jesus says wedding guests don't fast while the groom is there. New things don't fit old containers.

title: Lord of the Sabbath
summary: The disciples pick grain on the Sabbath and Pharisees object. Jesus points to David's example and says the Sabbath was made to help people.

title: Healing a Withered Hand
summary: On the Sabbath Jesus heals a man's withered hand while his critics watch, and they begin plotting against him. Large crowds keep following him.

title: Choosing the Twelve
summary: Jesus goes up a mountain and appoints twelve apostles to be with him and to preach. Back home, his family worries he's lost his mind.

title: A House Divided
summary: Religious scholars claim Jesus drives out demons by Satan's power. He answers that a divided kingdom can't stand, and warns against calling God's Spirit evil.

title: Who Is My Family?
summary: Jesus's mother and brothers arrive while he's teaching. He points to his listeners and says those who do God's will are his true family.

title: The Farmer and the Seeds
summary: Jesus tells a crowd by the lake about a farmer scattering seed on different kinds of ground. He explains he speaks in parables so only those who really listen will get it.

title: What the Soils Mean
summary: Jesus explains the parable: the seed is God's message, and the soils are the different ways people receive it. Some lose it, some give up, and some bear lots of fruit.

title: Don't Hide the Lamp
summary: A lamp is meant to be put on a stand, not hidden, and secrets will come to light. Jesus urges careful listening, since what you give attention to grows.

title: Seeds That Grow by Themselves
summary: Jesus compares God's kingdom to seed that grows on its own and to a tiny mustard seed that becomes a big plant. He explained everything privately to his disciples.

title: Jesus Calms the Storm
summary: A fierce storm hits the boat while Jesus sleeps. The disciples panic and wake him, and with a word he stills the wind and waves, leaving them in awe.

title: The Man Among the Tombs
summary: In the Gerasenes region, Jesus frees a tormented man from a legion of demons, which enter a herd of pigs. The locals ask Jesus to leave, but the healed man tells his story across the Decapolis.

title: A Woman Touches His Cloak
summary: On the way to Jairus's house, a woman suffering from bleeding for twelve years touches Jesus's cloak and is healed. He tells her her faith has made her well.

title: Jairus's Daughter
summary: Word comes that Jairus's daughter has died, but Jesus says not to fear. He takes her hand, tells her to get up, and she does.

title: Hometown Doubts
summary: In Nazareth, people who know Jesus as the carpenter take offense at him. He can do little there because of their unbelief.

title: The Twelve Are Sent Out
summary: Jesus sends the disciples out in pairs with authority over unclean spirits, traveling light. They preach, drive out demons and heal many.

title: The Death of John the Baptist
summary: Herod hears about Jesus and fears John has come back. The story flashes back to how Herod's wife Herodias schemed to have John beheaded after a birthday dance.

title: Feeding the Five Thousand
summary: Jesus tries to take the disciples away to rest, but crowds follow. He teaches them, then feeds about five thousand people with five loaves and two fish, with twelve baskets left over.

title: Walking on Water
summary: Jesus sends the disciples ahead by boat and prays alone. Seeing them struggle against the wind, he walks to them on the lake and calms the storm, then heals many at Gennesaret.

title: Clean Hands, Dirty Traditions
summary: Pharisees criticize the disciples for not washing hands ritually. Jesus calls out how they put human traditions above God's commands.

title: What Really Makes You Unclean
summary: Jesus says what comes out of a person, not what goes in, defiles them. He explains that evil comes from the heart.

title: A Mother's Persistent Faith
summary: In the region of Tyre, a Gentile woman begs Jesus to heal her demon-troubled daughter. Impressed by her quick reply, he tells her it's done.

title: Healing a Deaf Man
summary: In the Decapolis Jesus heals a deaf man who could barely speak. People are astonished, saying he does everything well.

title: Feeding the Four Thousand
summary: With another hungry crowd, Jesus takes seven loaves and a few fish and feeds about four thousand, with seven baskets left.

title: No Sign for Skeptics
summary: Pharisees demand a sign from heaven. Jesus sighs deeply and refuses, then leaves by boat.

title: Watch Out for Yeast
summary: Jesus warns about the yeast of the Pharisees and Herod, but the disciples think he's talking about bread. He reminds them of the baskets left over and wonders why they still don't get it.

title: A Blind Man Sees, Gradually
summary: At Bethsaida Jesus heals a blind man in two stages, first with blurry vision and then with perfect sight.

title: Who Do You Say I Am?
summary: Peter declares Jesus is the Christ. Jesus then says he must suffer and be killed and rise again, and rebukes Peter for objecting.

title: Take Up Your Cross
summary: Jesus tells the crowd that following him means giving up your own way, and that saving your life by clinging to it will lose it. Gaining the world isn't worth losing your soul.

title: Some Won't Taste Death
summary: Jesus says some standing there will see God's kingdom come with power before they die.

title: Glory on the Mountain
summary: On a high mountain Jesus is transfigured, shining white, with Moses and Elijah beside him. A voice from a cloud says to listen to his Son.

title: About Elijah
summary: Coming down, the disciples ask about Elijah. Jesus says Elijah has already come and was mistreated, and the Son of man will suffer too.

title: A Boy Who Needed Prayer
summary: The disciples can't heal a boy with a violent spirit. Jesus helps the father's shaky faith and frees the boy, saying this kind needs prayer.

title: Death Predicted Again
summary: Jesus quietly tells the disciples again that he'll be killed and rise after three days, but they don't understand.

title: Who Is the Greatest?
summary: The disciples argue over who is greatest. Jesus says whoever wants to be first must serve everyone, and welcomes a child as an example.

title: Whoever Isn't Against Us
summary: Jesus tells John not to stop an outsider doing good in his name. He then warns against causing others to stumble and urges peace and being salty.

title: Marriage and Divorce
summary: Pharisees test Jesus on divorce. He points back to God's design in creation that a husband and wife become one flesh, and explains further to his disciples.

title: Let the Children Come
summary: Jesus is annoyed when disciples shoo children away. He welcomes them and blesses them, saying the kingdom belongs to such as these.

title: The Rich Young Man
summary: A wealthy man asks how to inherit eternal life, but can't bring himself to sell everything for the poor. Jesus says it's hard for the rich to enter the kingdom, but all things are possible with God.

title: What Following Costs and Gains
summary: Peter notes they've left everything. Jesus promises rewards both now and in the age to come, and says the first will be last.

title: Heading Toward Jerusalem
summary: On the road up to Jerusalem, Jesus a third time tells the twelve he'll be mocked, killed and rise after three days.

title: Wanting the Best Seats
summary: James and John ask for places of honor. Jesus says true greatness is serving, as even he came to serve and give his life as a ransom.

title: Blind Bartimaeus Sees
summary: Near Jericho, blind Bartimaeus shouts for Jesus despite the crowd. Jesus heals him and he follows along.

title: Riding Into Jerusalem
summary: Jesus rides a borrowed colt into Jerusalem while crowds spread cloaks and branches and shout praise. He looks around the temple and heads out for the night.

title: The Fig Tree Fails
summary: Hungry, Jesus finds a leafy fig tree with no fruit and says no one will eat from it again.

title: Clearing the Temple
summary: Jesus drives out the merchants and moneychangers, saying God's house should be a house of prayer. The leaders start looking for a way to destroy him.

title: Faith and Forgiveness
summary: The next morning the fig tree is withered. Jesus teaches about faith, prayer and forgiving others.

title: By What Authority?
summary: Leaders challenge Jesus's authority. He asks whether John's baptism was from heaven or men, and when they refuse to answer, he refuses too.

title: The Wicked Farmers
summary: Jesus tells of tenants who killed the owner's servants and finally his son. The leaders realize the story is about them.

title: Pay Taxes to Caesar?
summary: Trying to trap Jesus, some ask whether paying tax to Caesar is lawful. He asks for a coin and says to give Caesar what's Caesar's and God what's God's.

title: Marriage in the Resurrection
summary: Sadducees pose a puzzle about a woman with seven husbands. Jesus says in the resurrection people are like angels, and God is the God of the living.

title: The Greatest Commandment
summary: A scribe asks which commandment is first. Jesus says to love God with everything and love your neighbor as yourself, and tells him he's near the kingdom.

title: Whose Son Is the Christ?
summary: Jesus asks how the Christ can be David's son if David called him Lord. The crowd listens gladly.

title: Beware of Show-Offs
summary: Jesus warns about scribes who love fancy robes and best seats while taking advantage of widows.

title: The Widow's Two Coins
summary: Jesus watches people give at the temple and notes a poor widow gave two small coins, more than the rich, because she gave all she had.

title: The Temple Will Fall
summary: Jesus predicts the temple's destruction. Privately, four disciples ask when, and he warns about deceivers, wars and earthquakes as only the start.

title: Hard Times for Followers
summary: Jesus warns his followers will face courts and beatings, and that the gospel will be preached to all nations. He says endurers will be saved.

title: Run for the Hills
summary: When they see the terrible desecration, those in Judea should flee quickly. Jesus warns of great distress and of false messiahs.

title: The Son of Man Returns
summary: After the distress, cosmic signs appear and the Son of man comes in clouds to gather his chosen ones. The fig tree shows summer is near, and his words will never pass away.

title: Stay Awake
summary: Only the Father knows the day or hour. Jesus tells everyone to watch, like servants awaiting their master's return.

title: The Plot Thickens
summary: With Passover two days away, the chief priests look for a sneaky way to arrest Jesus without a riot.

title: Perfume at Bethany
summary: At Simon's house, a woman pours expensive perfume on Jesus. Some complain about waste, but he says she's prepared him for burial, and she'll be remembered.

title: Judas Makes a Deal
summary: Judas Iscariot goes to the chief priests and agrees to betray Jesus for money.

title: The Passover Meal
summary: The disciples prepare the Passover in an upper room. At the table Jesus announces one of the twelve will betray him.

title: Bread and Cup
summary: Jesus gives the disciples bread and a cup, calling them his body and his blood of the covenant, poured out for many.

title: You'll All Scatter
summary: After singing a hymn, they go to the Mount of Olives. Jesus says all will fall away, and Peter insists he never will.

title: Praying in Gethsemane
summary: Deeply troubled, Jesus prays in the garden that the cup be taken away, yet says to do God's will. His three closest friends keep falling asleep.

title: Betrayed With a Kiss
summary: Judas arrives with an armed crowd and identifies Jesus with a kiss. Jesus is arrested, and the disciples flee.

title: Trial Before the Council
summary: Jesus is taken to the high priest, where false witnesses disagree. When he confirms he is the Christ, he's condemned and mocked.

title: Peter Denies Jesus
summary: In the courtyard Peter denies knowing Jesus three times. The rooster crows and he weeps, remembering Jesus's words.

title: Before Pilate
summary: Jesus is handed to Pilate, who finds no real crime. Under pressure from the crowd, he releases Barabbas and orders Jesus scourged and crucified.

title: Mocked and Crucified
summary: Soldiers mock Jesus with a purple robe and thorn crown, then crucify him at Golgotha between two robbers. People jeer, even the chief priests.

title: Jesus Dies
summary: Darkness falls for three hours, and Jesus cries out and dies. The temple curtain tears in two, and a centurion says this was truly God's Son.

title: Laid in the Tomb
summary: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus's body, wraps it in linen and lays it in a rock tomb, with a stone rolled across it.

title: The Empty Tomb
summary: At dawn on Sunday, women come to anoint Jesus and find the stone rolled away. A young man says Jesus is risen, and they flee in fear and amazement.

title: Appearances to Followers
summary: Jesus appears first to Mary Magdalene, then to two walking in the country, but others don't believe their reports.

title: The Great Commission
summary: Jesus appears to the eleven, scolds their doubt, and sends them to preach the gospel to everyone. He is taken up to heaven, and they go out preaching.

title: Luke's Opening Note
summary: Luke explains that he has carefully researched the story from eyewitnesses. He's writing it all down in order for his friend Theophilus so he can be sure of what he's been taught.

title: An Angel Visits a Priest
summary: Zacharias and Elisabeth are a good, older, childless couple. While Zacharias is serving in the temple, an angel appears and terrifies him.

title: A Son Named John
summary: The angel promises Elisabeth will have a son, John, who will bring joy and turn many people back to God, preparing the way for the Lord.

title: Zacharias Loses His Voice
summary: Zacharias doubts because of their age, so the angel Gabriel says he'll be unable to speak until the baby comes. Back home, Elisabeth becomes pregnant and is thrilled.

title: Gabriel Visits Mary
summary: The angel Gabriel tells Mary, a young woman in Nazareth, that she'll have a son named Jesus who will be king forever. Though puzzled, Mary says yes to God's plan.

title: Mary Meets Elisabeth
summary: Mary hurries to visit her relative Elisabeth. The baby inside Elisabeth leaps, and Elisabeth blesses Mary as mother of her Lord.

title: Mary's Song of Praise
summary: Mary bursts into song, praising God for lifting up the humble, feeding the hungry and keeping his promises to Israel. She stays about three months, then heads home.

title: John Is Born
summary: Elisabeth has her baby, and everyone expects him to be named after his dad. Elisabeth insists on John, and Zacharias confirms it in writing and can suddenly speak again.

title: Zacharias Sings a Prophecy
summary: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Zacharias praises God for rescuing his people and says little John will prepare the way for the Lord. John grows up and lives in the wilderness.

title: Jesus Is Born in Bethlehem
summary: A Roman census sends Joseph and pregnant Mary to Bethlehem. There Jesus is born and laid in a manger, since there's no room at the inn.

title: Shepherds and Angels
summary: Angels tell nearby shepherds that a Savior has been born, and a huge choir praises God. The shepherds rush to find the baby and spread the news.

title: Jesus Is Presented at the Temple
summary: Jesus is named and, following the law, his parents bring him to Jerusalem with the offering of two birds.

title: Simeon Holds the Baby
summary: Devout Simeon was promised he'd see the Messiah before dying. He takes Jesus in his arms, praises God, and warns Mary that this child will stir up deep reactions.

title: Anna Spreads the Word
summary: Elderly prophetess Anna thanks God and tells everyone about Jesus. The family then returns to Nazareth, where Jesus grows up wise and strong.

title: Twelve-Year-Old Jesus in the Temple
summary: On a Passover trip, Jesus stays behind in Jerusalem. His parents find him days later talking with teachers, and he says he had to be in his Father's house. He then goes home and keeps growing.

title: John Starts Preaching
summary: In a precisely dated moment, John begins preaching in the Jordan area, calling people to repent. This fulfills Isaiah's words about preparing the Lord's way.

title: What Should We Do?
summary: John warns crowds that real change must show up in how they live. He tells them to share, tax collectors to be fair, and soldiers to be honest and content.

title: Someone Greater Is Coming
summary: People wonder if John is the Messiah, but he says someone mightier is coming. Herod then has John thrown in prison for criticizing him.

title: Jesus Is Baptized
summary: Jesus is baptized and, as he prays, the Spirit comes down like a dove. A voice from heaven calls him the beloved Son.

title: Jesus's Family Tree
summary: Luke traces Jesus's ancestry, starting at about age thirty, all the way back through David and Abraham to Adam, the son of God.

title: Tested in the Desert
summary: Led by the Spirit, Jesus fasts forty days and the devil tempts him with bread, power and a daring temple jump. Jesus answers each time with Scripture.

title: Back in Galilee
summary: Jesus returns to Galilee in the Spirit's power. He teaches in synagogues and word about him spreads.

title: Rejected in Nazareth
summary: In his hometown synagogue, Jesus reads Isaiah and says it's being fulfilled right then. When he hints that outsiders were helped by prophets before, the crowd turns angry and tries to throw him off a cliff, but he walks away.

title: Authority Over an Evil Spirit
summary: In Capernaum, Jesus teaches with striking authority and orders an evil spirit out of a man. The crowd is amazed.

title: Healing Many
summary: Jesus heals Simon's mother-in-law and then many sick people at sunset. He slips away early, saying he must preach in other towns too.

title: Fishing for People
summary: Jesus teaches from Simon's boat, then tells him to fish again. The huge catch amazes Simon, James and John, who leave everything to follow Jesus.

title: Healing a Man with Leprosy
summary: Jesus touches a man with leprosy and heals him, telling him to show himself to the priest. News spreads, and Jesus often retreats to pray.

title: Lowered Through the Roof
summary: Friends lower a paralyzed man through a roof to reach Jesus. Jesus forgives his sins, then heals him to show he has authority to do so.

title: Levi's Dinner Party
summary: Jesus calls tax collector Levi, who throws a big feast. When critics object to the company, Jesus says he came for those who need healing, not the healthy.

title: Fasting and New Wine
summary: Asked why his followers don't fast, Jesus compares his presence to a wedding. He adds that new wine and patches don't suit old containers and clothes.

title: Lord of the Sabbath
summary: Jesus defends his disciples picking grain on the Sabbath and then heals a man's withered hand. His critics are furious and start plotting.

title: Choosing the Twelve
summary: After praying all night on a mountain, Jesus picks twelve disciples to be apostles, including Peter, John and Judas Iscariot.

title: Crowds Seek Healing
summary: A huge crowd from all over comes to hear Jesus and be healed, and power flows from him to everyone who touches him.

title: Blessings and Warnings
summary: Jesus says the poor, hungry and mourning are blessed, and that those who are comfortable and popular should be careful.

title: Love Your Enemies
summary: Jesus teaches radical kindness: love enemies, give freely, treat others as you want to be treated, be merciful, and don't judge.

title: Specks and Good Fruit
summary: Jesus uses a blind guide, a speck and a plank, and fruit trees to say: fix yourself first, and your character shows in what you produce.

title: Build on Rock
summary: Jesus asks why people call him Lord but ignore him. Those who act on his words are like a house built on rock, safe in a flood.

title: The Centurion's Faith
summary: A Roman officer asks Jesus to heal his dying servant but says Jesus needn't come, since a word is enough. Jesus is amazed by his faith, and the servant is healed.

title: A Widow's Son Raised
summary: At Nain, Jesus meets a funeral for a widow's only son. Moved with compassion, he tells the young man to rise, and he does.

title: John's Question
summary: From prison, John sends followers to ask if Jesus is the one. Jesus points to the healings and good news happening, and says to trust him.

title: Jesus Praises John
summary: Jesus tells the crowd John was a prophet and more, the messenger sent ahead of him. He says people criticize both John and himself no matter what.

title: A Woman Washes Jesus's Feet
summary: At a Pharisee's dinner, a woman weeps on Jesus's feet and anoints them. Jesus explains through a debt story that those forgiven much love much, and sends her off in peace.

title: Women Who Followed Jesus
summary: Jesus tours towns preaching, with the twelve and several women he'd healed, such as Mary Magdalene and Joanna, who help support the group.

title: The Sower and the Seed
summary: Jesus tells of a farmer scattering seed on different soils, then explains it: people respond to God's message in different ways, and good soil bears lots of fruit.

title: Don't Hide the Light
summary: Jesus says a lamp belongs on a stand and hidden things will come out, so pay close attention to how you listen.

title: Who Is Jesus's Family?
summary: When his mother and brothers can't get through the crowd, Jesus says his true family are those who hear God's word and do it.

title: Jesus Calms the Storm
summary: A fierce storm hits the lake while Jesus naps. The panicked disciples wake him, he calms wind and waves, and they wonder who he is.

title: The Man Called Legion
summary: In Gadarene country, Jesus frees a tormented man from many demons, sending them into a herd of pigs. The man is healed and told to tell his story.

title: Jairus Asks for Help
summary: Back across the lake, a synagogue leader named Jairus begs Jesus to come heal his dying twelve-year-old daughter.

title: A Woman Touches His Cloak
summary: On the way, a woman sick for twelve years touches Jesus's cloak and is healed. Jesus finds her and tells her that her faith made her well.

title: Jairus's Daughter Revived
summary: News comes that the girl has died, but Jesus says to believe. He takes her hand, tells her to get up, and she does.

title: Sending Out the Twelve
summary: Jesus gives the twelve power to heal and preach, and sends them out traveling light. Herod hears the buzz and wonders who Jesus really is.

title: Feeding the Five Thousand
summary: Jesus takes five loaves and two fish, blesses them, and feeds about five thousand people, with twelve baskets left over.

title: Who Do You Say I Am?
summary: Peter declares Jesus is God's Christ. Jesus then tells the disciples he'll suffer, be killed and rise on the third day.

title: Take Up Your Cross
summary: Jesus says following him means giving up your own way. Saving your life by holding on tight loses it, and gaining the world isn't worth losing yourself.

title: Glory on the Mountain
summary: On a mountain, Jesus's appearance turns dazzling as Moses and Elijah talk with him. A voice from a cloud says to listen to Jesus, the Son.

title: Healing a Boy
summary: At the foot of the mountain, Jesus heals a boy with a violent spirit after the disciples fail. He again warns that he will be handed over, but they don't get it.

title: Who's the Greatest?
summary: The disciples argue about who's greatest. Jesus puts a child beside him and says the least is the greatest, and not to block others doing good.

title: Turned Away in Samaria
summary: Jesus sets out for Jerusalem, and a Samaritan village refuses him. James and John want to call down fire, but Jesus rebukes them.

title: The Cost of Following
summary: Jesus tells would-be followers that discipleship is costly. They must put him first and not look back once they start.

title: Sending the Seventy
summary: Jesus sends seventy others ahead in pairs to heal and announce God's kingdom. He warns of rejection and says those who listen to them listen to him.

title: The Seventy Return
summary: The seventy come back thrilled by their success. Jesus tells them to rejoice most that their names are in heaven, then thanks the Father privately.

title: The Good Samaritan
summary: Asked who his neighbor is, Jesus tells of a Samaritan who rescues a beaten stranger after a priest and a Levite walk by. Be a neighbor like that.

title: Martha and Mary
summary: Martha is busy hosting while her sister Mary sits listening to Jesus. Jesus gently says Mary chose the better thing.

title: Teach Us to Pray
summary: Jesus gives the disciples a model prayer, and tells of a friend who persists at midnight. Keep asking, seeking and knocking, since the Father gives good gifts.

title: Accused of Using Evil Power
summary: After Jesus heals a mute man, some say it's by Beelzebub's power. Jesus points out the logic fails, and says God's power is overcoming evil.

title: Truly Blessed
summary: A woman praises Jesus's mother. Jesus replies that those who hear God's word and obey it are even more blessed.

title: The Sign of Jonah
summary: Jesus says this generation wants a sign but will get only Jonah's. People who responded to Jonah and Solomon will judge them. He also talks about light and the eye.

title: Woes to the Pharisees
summary: At a Pharisee's dinner, Jesus criticizes the focus on outward cleanliness while ignoring justice and love of God, and calls out their pride.

title: Woes to the Lawyers
summary: Jesus tells the experts in the law that they burden people, honor dead prophets while rejecting living ones, and block the way to knowledge. The leaders begin plotting against him.

title: Beware Hypocrisy, Don't Fear
summary: Jesus warns about hypocrisy and says hidden things will come out. He urges his friends to fear God rather than people, since God cares even about sparrows, and to trust the Spirit under pressure.

title: The Rich Fool
summary: Asked to settle an inheritance dispute, Jesus warns against greed and tells of a rich farmer who stores up goods but dies that night.

title: Don't Worry
summary: Jesus tells his disciples not to fret about food and clothes. God feeds ravens and dresses lilies, and he'll care for you far more.

title: Treasure and Being Ready
summary: Seek God's kingdom, give generously, and put your treasure in heaven. Be ready like servants awaiting their master's return.

title: The Faithful Servant
summary: Peter asks who the parable is for. Jesus describes a servant managing the household, rewarded if faithful but punished if careless, and more is expected from those given more.

title: Jesus Brings Division
summary: Jesus says his coming will cause conflict, even splitting families, and he feels pressure about the ordeal ahead.

title: Read the Times
summary: Jesus tells the crowd they can read weather signs but can't read the present moment, and should judge for themselves what's right.

title: Settle Up Quickly
summary: Jesus advises settling with your opponent on the way to court, or you'll end up in prison until you've paid every last cent.

title: Repent or Perish
summary: Some people mention Galileans Pilate killed. Jesus says they weren't worse sinners than anyone else, and neither were those crushed by the Siloam tower. His point: everyone needs to change course.

title: The Fig Tree Gets One More Year
summary: A man finds his fig tree fruitless for three years and wants it cut down. The gardener begs for one more year of care first.

title: Healing a Bent-Over Woman on the Sabbath
summary: Jesus frees a woman crippled for eighteen years. A synagogue leader objects to healing on the sabbath, but Jesus points out everyone helps their animals that day. His critics are shamed and the crowd rejoices.

title: Mustard Seed and Yeast
summary: Jesus compares God's kingdom to a tiny mustard seed that grows into a big tree, and to yeast that works through a whole batch of dough.

title: The Narrow Door
summary: Heading toward Jerusalem, Jesus is asked if only a few will be saved. He urges people to push for the narrow door before it's shut, warning that some who assume they're in will be left out and the last will be first.

title: Jesus and 'That Fox' Herod
summary: Some Pharisees warn that Herod wants to kill Jesus. He shrugs it off, saying he'll keep going, then laments over Jerusalem, longing to gather it like a hen gathers her chicks.

title: Healing on the Sabbath, Again
summary: Dining at a Pharisee's house, Jesus heals a man with swelling (dropsy) and asks if healing on the sabbath is lawful. No one answers, and he points out they'd rescue a child or ox in a well on that day.

title: Don't Grab the Best Seat
summary: Noticing guests picking the top seats, Jesus advises taking the lowest place. Those who lift themselves up get humbled, and the humble get lifted up.

title: Invite Those Who Can't Pay You Back
summary: Jesus tells the host to invite the poor, lame and blind rather than friends who'll return the favor. God will repay him later.

title: The Great Supper
summary: Jesus tells of a big banquet where invited guests make excuses. The host then fills the hall with the poor and outcasts from the streets and roads.

title: The Cost of Following Jesus
summary: Jesus tells the crowds that following him takes total commitment. He compares it to counting the cost before building a tower or going to war, and warns that salt that's lost its flavor is useless.

title: Jesus Eats with Sinners
summary: Tax collectors and sinners gather to hear Jesus, and the Pharisees grumble that he welcomes and eats with them.

title: The Lost Sheep
summary: A shepherd leaves ninety-nine sheep to find the one that's lost, then celebrates. Heaven rejoices likewise over one sinner who repents.

title: The Lost Coin
summary: A woman loses one of ten silver coins, searches the house until she finds it, and throws a party. Angels celebrate the same way over one repentant sinner.

title: The Prodigal Son Comes Home
summary: A younger son takes his inheritance, squanders it, and ends up feeding pigs. He heads home expecting to be a servant, but his father runs to welcome him with a feast.

title: The Older Brother's Grumble
summary: The older brother is angry about the party for his wayward sibling. His father gently reminds him that everything he has is his, and that celebrating the lost one's return is only right.

title: The Shrewd Manager
summary: A manager about to be fired cuts his master's debtors' bills to win friends. Jesus uses it to talk about using money wisely and being trustworthy with little and much.

title: God or Money
summary: Jesus says no one can serve two masters, God and money. The money-loving Pharisees scoff, and he says God knows their hearts and what people value highly is detestable to him.

title: The Rich Man and Lazarus
summary: A rich man ignores poor Lazarus at his gate. After death Lazarus is comforted while the rich man suffers, and Abraham says that if his brothers won't heed Moses and the prophets, even someone rising from the dead won't convince them.

title: Don't Cause Others to Stumble
summary: Jesus warns that temptations will come, but it's terrible for anyone who causes a little one to stumble.

title: Forgive and Have Faith
summary: Jesus says to forgive a brother who repents, even seven times a day. The apostles ask for more faith, and he says faith as small as a mustard seed can do great things, and servants simply do their duty.

title: Ten Lepers, One Thank-You
summary: Jesus heals ten lepers on the road near Samaria and Galilee. Only one, a Samaritan, comes back to thank him.

title: The Kingdom and the Coming Son of Man
summary: Asked when God's kingdom comes, Jesus says it's already among them. He then describes his future return as sudden, like lightning or the days of Noah and Lot, and tells people to be ready.

title: The Persistent Widow
summary: Jesus tells of a widow who keeps pestering an unjust judge until he gives her justice. If even he caves, how much more will God answer his people.

title: The Pharisee and the Tax Collector
summary: Two men pray in the temple: one brags about himself, the other humbly asks for mercy. Jesus says the humble one went home right with God.

title: Let the Children Come
summary: People bring babies to Jesus and the disciples scold them. Jesus welcomes the kids and says God's kingdom belongs to those who receive it like a child.

title: The Rich Ruler
summary: A wealthy ruler asks how to inherit eternal life, but walks away sad when Jesus tells him to sell everything and follow. Jesus says with God the impossible can happen, and promises rewards to those who give things up for the kingdom.

title: Jesus Predicts His Death Again
summary: Jesus tells the twelve they're going to Jerusalem where he'll be mocked, killed and rise on the third day. They don't understand.

title: A Blind Man Sees in Jericho
summary: A blind beggar near Jericho shouts for Jesus despite people telling him to hush. Jesus restores his sight, and he follows Jesus praising God.

title: Zacchaeus Up a Tree
summary: Short tax collector Zacchaeus climbs a sycamore to see Jesus, who invites himself to dinner. Zacchaeus vows to give to the poor and repay fourfold, and Jesus says salvation has come to his house.

title: The Parable of the Ten Servants
summary: As they near Jerusalem, Jesus tells of a nobleman who leaves servants with money to invest. On return, he rewards the productive ones, scolds the one who hid his, and deals with his enemies.

title: Riding into Jerusalem
summary: Jesus sends disciples to fetch a colt and rides it toward Jerusalem while followers praise God. Pharisees want them silenced, but Jesus says the stones would cry out.

title: Jesus Weeps and Clears the Temple
summary: Jesus weeps over Jerusalem, predicting its destruction. He then drives merchants out of the temple, and teaches there daily while leaders plot against him.

title: Who Gave You Authority?
summary: Priests and elders challenge Jesus' authority. He counters by asking whether John's baptism was from heaven or men, and when they dodge, he declines to answer.

title: The Wicked Vineyard Tenants
summary: Jesus tells of tenants who beat and kill the owner's servants and finally his son. The leaders realize the story is about them.

title: Paying Taxes to Caesar
summary: Spies try to trap Jesus about paying taxes to Rome. He asks for a coin and says to give Caesar what's Caesar's and God what's God's, leaving them amazed.

title: The Sadducees and the Resurrection
summary: Sadducees, who deny resurrection, pose a puzzle about a woman married to seven brothers. Jesus answers that people in the age to come are like angels, and God is God of the living.

title: Whose Son Is the Messiah?
summary: Jesus asks how the Messiah can be David's son if David calls him Lord. He then warns the crowd about scribes who show off and exploit widows.

title: The Widow's Two Coins
summary: Jesus sees rich people giving big gifts, then a poor widow giving two tiny coins. He says she gave the most because she gave all she had.

title: Signs of the Temple's Fall
summary: Admiring the temple, the disciples hear it will be torn down. Jesus warns of deceivers, wars, persecution and Jerusalem surrounded by armies, telling people to stay steady and flee when it happens.

title: The Son of Man Is Coming
summary: Jesus describes signs in the sky and sea and the Son of Man coming in a cloud. Like leaves on a fig tree signal summer, these signs show the kingdom is near.

title: Stay Alert
summary: Jesus tells them not to be weighed down by partying and worry, but to stay watchful and pray. He teaches in the temple by day and stays on the Mount of Olives at night.

title: Judas Makes a Deal
summary: With Passover near, the chief priests look for a way to get rid of Jesus. Judas offers to betray him for money.

title: Preparing the Passover
summary: Jesus sends Peter and John to prepare the Passover meal, giving signs to find a man with a water jar and an upper room.

title: The Last Supper
summary: Jesus shares the Passover with his apostles. He gives them bread and wine as his body and the new covenant in his blood, to remember him.

title: A Betrayer at the Table
summary: Jesus says his betrayer is at the table with him. The disciples wonder which of them it could be.

title: Who Is the Greatest?
summary: The disciples argue about who is greatest. Jesus says real greatness means serving, as he does, and promises them a place in his kingdom.

title: Peter's Denial Predicted
summary: Jesus tells Simon Peter that Satan wants to sift them, but he's prayed for him. Peter swears loyalty, yet Jesus says he'll deny him three times before the rooster crows.

title: Praying on the Mount of Olives
summary: Jesus prays in anguish, asking if the cup can pass but submitting to God's will. An angel strengthens him while the disciples sleep.

title: Judas Arrives with a Crowd
summary: Judas leads a crowd and greets Jesus with a kiss. The disciples ask if they should fight.

title: Jesus Heals a Servant's Ear
summary: A disciple cuts off the ear of the high priest's servant. Jesus says 'No more of this' and heals him, then tells the crowd this is their hour of darkness.

title: Peter Denies Jesus
summary: Jesus is taken to the high priest's house. Peter warms himself by a fire and denies knowing Jesus three times, then the rooster crows and Jesus looks at him. Peter weeps bitterly.

title: The Guards Mock Jesus
summary: The men holding Jesus mock him, blindfold and hit him, and demand he prophesy who struck him.

title: Jesus Before the Council
summary: At daybreak the elders question Jesus. He says the Son of Man will sit at God's right hand, and they take that as enough to condemn him.

title: Jesus Before Pilate
summary: The council brings Jesus to Pilate, accusing him of stirring up the people. Pilate finds no fault and, hearing he's from Galilee, sends him to Herod.

title: Herod Mocks Jesus
summary: Herod hopes to see a miracle, but Jesus stays silent. Herod's soldiers mock him and dress him in a fancy robe.

title: Unlikely Friends
summary: Herod and Pilate, who were enemies, become friends that day.

title: Barabbas Over Jesus
summary: Pilate says he finds Jesus innocent, but the crowd shouts to crucify him and free Barabbas instead. Pilate gives in, and Simon of Cyrene is made to carry the cross.

title: The Road to the Cross
summary: Women mourn as Jesus walks to Golgotha. He tells them to weep for themselves and their children instead, and he is crucified between two criminals.

title: Father, Forgive Them
summary: On the cross Jesus prays for forgiveness for those responsible. Soldiers cast lots for his clothes and rulers mock him, with a sign reading 'King of the Jews.'

title: The Thief on the Cross
summary: One criminal mocks Jesus; the other asks to be remembered. Jesus promises him paradise that day. Darkness falls and the temple curtain tears.

title: Jesus Dies
summary: Jesus commits his spirit to the Father and dies. A centurion praises God, saying he was innocent, and the crowd leaves heartbroken.

title: Burial in Joseph's Tomb
summary: Joseph of Arimathea, a member of the council who disagreed with its decision, asks for Jesus' body and lays it in a new tomb. The women watch, then prepare spices as the sabbath begins.

title: The Empty Tomb
summary: At dawn on Sunday the women find the stone rolled away and the tomb empty. Two angels tell them Jesus has risen as he said. The apostles think it nonsense, though Peter runs to see.

title: A Stranger on the Emmaus Road
summary: Two followers walking to Emmaus, sad about Jesus' death, are joined by a stranger who explains how Scripture pointed to the Messiah.

title: Recognized in the Breaking of Bread
summary: They invite the stranger to stay, and recognize Jesus when he breaks bread. He vanishes, and they rush back to Jerusalem to tell the others.

title: Jesus Appears to the Disciples
summary: Jesus appears among the disciples, who are startled. He shows his hands and feet, eats fish, and explains the Scriptures to them.

title: Wait for Power
summary: Jesus tells them to stay in Jerusalem until they're given power from above.

title: Jesus Ascends
summary: Jesus leads them to Bethany, blesses them and is taken up into heaven. They worship him and return to Jerusalem filled with joy, praising God in the temple.

title: In the Beginning Was the Word
summary: John opens by saying the Word was with God and was God, made everything, and brought life and light that darkness couldn't put out.

title: John Points to the Light
summary: A man named John was sent to testify about the true Light coming into the world. Many didn't recognize him, but those who did became children of God.

title: The Word Becomes Human
summary: The Word became flesh and lived among us, full of grace and truth. John says Jesus, God's only Son, shows us what God is like.

title: John the Baptist: Not the Messiah
summary: Religious leaders ask John who he is. He says he's not the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet, just a voice preparing the way, baptizing at Bethabara.

title: Behold the Lamb of God
summary: John sees Jesus and calls him the Lamb of God who takes away the world's sin. He saw the Spirit descend on him like a dove and declares him God's Son.

title: The First Disciples
summary: Two of John's followers, including Andrew, follow Jesus and spend the day with him. Andrew then brings his brother Simon, whom Jesus renames Cephas, or Peter.

title: Philip and Nathanael
summary: Jesus calls Philip, who fetches Nathanael. Nathanael is skeptical about Nazareth but amazed when Jesus knows him, and Jesus promises he'll see greater things.

title: Water Into Wine at Cana
summary: At a wedding in Cana, the wine runs out. Jesus has servants fill jars with water and it becomes excellent wine, his first sign, and his disciples believe.

title: Jesus Clears the Temple
summary: At Passover in Jerusalem, Jesus drives out merchants and money changers from the temple. He speaks of raising the temple in three days, meaning his own body.

title: Born Again: Nicodemus Visits
summary: Nicodemus, a Pharisee, comes to Jesus by night. Jesus tells him he must be born again of water and Spirit, and that the Son of Man must be lifted up.

title: For God So Loved the World
summary: God gave his Son so that whoever believes won't perish but have eternal life. Light has come, but some prefer darkness because their deeds are evil.

title: John: He Must Increase
summary: Jesus and John both baptize. John says he's just the friend of the bridegroom, rejoicing that Jesus must increase while he decreases.

title: A Drink at Jacob's Well
summary: Jesus rests at a well in Samaria and asks a woman for a drink, which surprises her. He offers her living water that satisfies forever.

title: True Worship
summary: Jesus reveals he knows her past, and she realizes he is a prophet. He says true worship is in spirit and truth, and admits he is the Messiah.

title: Many Samaritans Believe
summary: The woman tells her town about Jesus. The disciples urge him to eat, but he says doing God's will is his food, and many Samaritans believe.

title: Healing an Official's Son
summary: Back in Galilee, a royal official begs Jesus to heal his dying son at Capernaum. Jesus says the boy lives, and he does, so the whole household believes.

title: Healing at the Pool of Bethesda
summary: Jesus heals a man who's been disabled for 38 years beside a pool in Jerusalem. It's the Sabbath, and he tells the man to pick up his bed and walk.

title: Jesus Claims Authority From the Father
summary: Leaders want to kill Jesus for healing on the Sabbath and calling God his Father. He says the Son does what the Father does, giving life and judging.

title: Witnesses to Jesus
summary: Jesus lists who vouches for him: John, his works, the Father, and the Scriptures. He says the leaders study the Scriptures yet won't come to him for life.

title: Feeding the Five Thousand
summary: A huge crowd follows Jesus. With five barley loaves and two fish from a boy, he feeds about 5,000 people with twelve baskets left over.

title: Jesus Walks on Water
summary: That night the disciples row across the stormy Sea of Galilee. Jesus walks to them on the water, says it's him, and the boat arrives at shore.

title: The Bread of Life
summary: The crowd chases Jesus for more bread. He tells them to seek food that lasts and says he is the bread of life; whoever comes to him won't hunger.

title: Grumbling Over the Bread
summary: People murmur because they know his family. Jesus says he's the living bread from heaven and that those who eat it will live forever.

title: Many Leave, Peter Stays
summary: Many disciples find this too hard and walk away. Jesus asks the Twelve if they'll leave too, and Peter says they have nowhere else to go.

title: Brothers Urge Jesus to Go Public
summary: Before the Feast of Tabernacles, Jesus' brothers tell him to show himself in Judea. He stays back for now, and people argue about him.

title: Teaching in the Temple
summary: Midway through the feast Jesus teaches in the temple. He says his teaching is from God and challenges people to judge fairly, not by appearances.

title: Is This the Christ?
summary: Some in Jerusalem wonder if he might be the Christ. Officials try to arrest him, but Jesus says he'll be with them a little longer, then go where they can't.

title: Rivers of Living Water
summary: On the last day of the feast, Jesus invites the thirsty to come and drink. The crowd is divided, and the officers sent to arrest him come back empty-handed.

title: The Woman Caught in Adultery
summary: Leaders bring a woman caught in adultery to test Jesus. He says whoever is without sin should throw the first stone, and everyone leaves; he tells her to sin no more.

title: Light of the World
summary: Jesus says he is the light of the world. The Pharisees challenge his testimony, and he says he comes from above and the Father is with him.

title: Truth and Freedom
summary: Jesus tells believers the truth will set them free. They claim Abraham as their father, but he says they're slaves to sin and don't act like Abraham.

title: Before Abraham Was, I Am
summary: Jesus says Abraham rejoiced to see his day, and declares, 'Before Abraham was, I am.' The crowd picks up stones, but he slips away.

title: A Man Born Blind Sees
summary: Jesus sees a man blind from birth, makes mud with spittle, and sends him to wash in the pool of Siloam. The man comes back able to see.

title: Pharisees Investigate the Healing
summary: The Pharisees grill the man about the Sabbath healing and call his parents in. They stay cautious, fearing expulsion, and tell the leaders to ask him.

title: The Healed Man Stands Firm
summary: The man sticks to his story: once blind, now he sees. He mocks their stubbornness, and they throw him out.

title: Spiritual Blindness
summary: Jesus finds the man and he believes in the Son of Man. Jesus says he came so the blind may see, and those who claim to see remain guilty.

title: The Good Shepherd
summary: Jesus describes himself as the door and the good shepherd who lays down his life for the sheep. They know his voice, and he lays down his life by his own choice.

title: I and My Father Are One
summary: The crowd is divided. At the Feast of Dedication, people ask if he's the Christ; he says his works show it and that he and the Father are one.

title: Stones and Escape
summary: They pick up stones for blasphemy. Jesus points to his works, and he slips away across the Jordan, where many believe.

title: Lazarus Is Sick and Dies
summary: Lazarus of Bethany is ill, and his sisters Mary and Martha send word to Jesus. He waits two days, then says Lazarus has died and heads toward Judea.

title: I Am the Resurrection
summary: Lazarus has been in the tomb four days. Martha meets Jesus, who tells her he is the resurrection and the life, and she affirms he is the Christ.

title: Jesus Weeps
summary: Mary and the mourners weep, and Jesus is deeply moved and weeps too. Some ask why he couldn't keep Lazarus from dying.

title: Jesus Raises Lazarus
summary: At the tomb Jesus prays, then calls Lazarus out. The man who'd been dead four days walks out, and many who see it believe.

title: The Plot to Kill Jesus
