summary: Alarmed, the chief priests and Pharisees meet. Caiaphas says one man should die for the people, and they plan to kill Jesus.

title: Mary Anoints Jesus
summary: Six days before Passover, Mary pours expensive perfume on Jesus' feet at Bethany. Judas complains, but Jesus says it's for his burial.

title: Triumphal Entry
summary: Crowds wave palm branches as Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey, shouting praise to the King of Israel. The Pharisees despair.

title: A Grain of Wheat Must Die
summary: Some Greeks want to see Jesus. He says a grain of wheat must die to bear fruit, that he'll be lifted up, and urges people to walk in the light.

title: Unbelief and Belief
summary: Despite his signs, many don't believe, as Isaiah foretold. Some leaders believe secretly, and Jesus says he came as light, not to judge.

title: Jesus Washes the Disciples' Feet
summary: At the Last Supper Jesus washes his disciples' feet, even Peter's after some protest. He tells them to serve one another the same way.

title: Betrayal Foretold
summary: Jesus says one of the Twelve will betray him. He hands bread to Judas, who leaves into the night.

title: A New Commandment
summary: Jesus gives a new command: love one another as he loved them. Peter swears he'll die for him, but Jesus says he'll deny him three times.

title: The Way, the Truth, the Life
summary: Jesus comforts the disciples: he's preparing a place for them. He says he is the way, the truth, and the life, and that seeing him means seeing the Father.

title: The Comforter Promised
summary: Jesus promises the Holy Spirit as a helper and leaves them his peace. He tells them not to be troubled or afraid.

title: The Vine and the Branches
summary: Jesus says he's the true vine and his followers are branches. Stay connected to him and you'll bear much fruit.

title: Love One Another
summary: Jesus commands his disciples to love each other as he loves them, calling them friends, not servants.

title: The World's Hatred
summary: Jesus warns that the world will hate his followers as it hated him. The Spirit of truth will testify about him.

title: The Spirit Will Guide You
summary: Jesus warns of persecution to come. He says it's good he goes away, because the Spirit will come, convict the world, and guide them into truth.

title: Sorrow Turns to Joy
summary: Jesus says their grief will turn to joy, like a mother after childbirth. He tells them to ask in his name, and that though trouble comes, he has overcome the world.

title: Jesus Prays for Himself
summary: Jesus prays that the Father will glorify him, defining eternal life as knowing the Father and the Son.

title: Jesus Prays for His Disciples
summary: He prays for the disciples God gave him, asking that they be protected, unified, and made holy in truth.

title: Jesus Prays for All Believers
summary: Jesus prays for everyone who will believe through their message, asking that they be one and share in God's love.

title: Jesus Is Arrested
summary: In a garden across the Kidron, Judas leads soldiers to Jesus. He identifies himself, Peter slashes a servant's ear, and Jesus is led away to Annas.

title: Peter Denies Jesus
summary: While Jesus is questioned by the high priest, Peter warms by a fire and denies knowing him three times. The rooster crows.

title: Jesus Before Pilate
summary: The leaders bring Jesus to Pilate. Jesus says his kingdom isn't of this world; Pilate finds no fault but the crowd demands Barabbas instead.

title: Condemned to Be Crucified
summary: Jesus is flogged, mocked with a crown of thorns, and presented to the crowd. Pilate gives in to shouts of 'Crucify him!'

title: The Crucifixion
summary: Jesus is crucified at Golgotha with a sign reading King of the Jews. He asks John to care for his mother and says 'It is finished.'

title: Jesus Is Buried
summary: Soldiers pierce Jesus' side to confirm he's dead. Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap his body and lay it in a new tomb.

title: The Empty Tomb
summary: Mary Magdalene finds the stone rolled away. Peter and John run to the tomb and find the grave clothes but no body.

title: Jesus Appears to Mary
summary: Mary weeps at the tomb, then mistakes Jesus for the gardener until he says her name. She goes to tell the disciples.

title: Jesus Appears to the Disciples
summary: That evening Jesus appears through locked doors, says 'Peace be with you,' and breathes on them to receive the Holy Spirit.

title: Doubting Thomas
summary: Thomas won't believe without seeing. A week later Jesus shows him his wounds, and Thomas says 'My Lord and my God.' John says these signs are written so you may believe.

title: Breakfast on the Beach
summary: After a fruitless night of fishing, the disciples follow a stranger's advice and haul in 153 fish. It's Jesus, who cooks them breakfast on the shore.

title: Feed My Sheep
summary: Jesus asks Peter three times if he loves him, telling him to feed his sheep, and hints at Peter's future. John closes by noting Jesus did far more than could be written.
